notes.title: Added "Naked foot" function
notes.notes:
· You can choose whether to wear shoes or not in the changing room
· In the level, the heroine's shoes will be automatically displayed or hidden according to the Settings

notes.title: Added 【 Defeated CG】!
notes.notes: · Added the first level, CG after defeat.

notes.title: 【 Added optional clothing function 】
notes.notes:
· Added the optional clothing function
· Players can select their favorite costume by clicking on "Changing Room" in the beginning scene
Later in the game level, the protagonist will wear a personalized costume chosen by the player to fight
· Currently there are two sets of costumes: "White collar" and "secret agent"
· Players are welcome to post suggestions in the comments section if they have a costume they would like to update
· Your likes are the motivation for us to update!

notes.title: Some bugs have been modified
notes.notes:
· Fixed the bug of zone reset
· Fixed a bug where guards cheat corpses

notes.title: Added prompt text and prompt tone
notes.notes:
When spotted by the enemy:
· Enhanced enemy discovery sound
· Added text indicating the cause of discovery
· Added a system alarm tone when being pursued
The reasons for being found include but are not limited to the following:
· Holding contraband (swinging sticks)
· Taking hostages
・ Body removal
· Body found
· Changing clothes and camouflage
